description: Host-policy operation edges: a denied push is abandoned, the task is paused and resumed into pr, and a superseding push with a fresh approval runs; merge (at the pushed head) is user-approved and gives the integration its completion evidence; an expired destructive-command approval; a push killed by cancellation (outcome_unknown, cause killed) and reconciled afterwards; a cleanup operation left outcome_unknown by a crash after the task ended (needs reconcile); a crash between approval and start (recovery invalidates the unused grant and abandons the recorded operation).
